tasks.prompt: You are a Google Search Console expert. What are ALL the signs of a Google manual action for 'unnatural links to your site'? List every indicator visible in GSC: notifications, messages, manual action panel entries, coverage changes, impression drops. Be exhaustive.

Step-by-step instructions to check Google Search Console for manual actions in June 2026. Include: where to find Manual Actions panel, Security & Manual Actions section, what each action type means, how to read the notification. Also check: are there any new GSC interface changes in 2026?

A Chrome extension website (belikenative.com) deployed 984 backlinks across 9 platforms (Dev.to, Telegraph, GitHub Pages, GitLab Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Vercel, Surge.sh, Firebase, HuggingFace Spaces) in 10 days (May 26 - Jun 5, 2026). It's now Jun 9 — 4 days of zero new links. What is the current SpamBrain detection risk? Has the 4-day pause helped? What risk score would you assign (1-10)?

How long does Google typically take to issue a manual action after detecting a link spam pattern? If 984 links were deployed May 26 - Jun 5 and no manual action has appeared by Jun 9, does that mean we're safe? Or could it still come later? Give timeline analysis.

What GSC impression and click patterns indicate a SILENT algorithmic penalty (no manual action notification) vs an actual manual action? How to differentiate between the two? What specific metrics to monitor daily?

Google SpamBrain link detection: does it analyze backlink velocity in real-time or in batch processing? How often does SpamBrain re-evaluate a site's link profile? If a site stops building links, how long before SpamBrain's risk assessment decreases?

Analyze this backlink profile for penalty risk: 984 total links across Dev.to (127), Telegraph (126), GitHub Pages (128), GitLab (127), Cloudflare Pages (128), Vercel (127), Surge.sh (127), HuggingFace (38), Firebase (13). All links point to belikenative.com articles. All deployed within 10 days. All are article pages with anchor text variations. What specific penalty signals does this trigger?

If Google has NOT issued a manual action for 984 automated backlinks after 14 days (Jun 17), can we assume it's safe? What percentage of link spam manual actions are issued within 14 days vs 30 days vs 90 days? Give statistical analysis of manual action timing.

How to check if Google has indexed HuggingFace Spaces pages? What's the typical indexation rate for HuggingFace static Spaces? Do they pass PageRank effectively? Are HuggingFace backlinks valuable for SEO in 2026?

Dev.to articles — what percentage typically get indexed by Google? How long does indexation take? Do Dev.to canonical tags affect backlink value? Are Dev.to backlinks still dofollow in 2026? Has Dev.to made any changes to link attributes?

GitLab Pages sites — are they indexed by Google? What's the typical indexation timeline? If robots.txt blocks some pages, does unblocking them trigger a re-crawl? How long after unblocking does Google discover and index?

Cloudflare Pages deployment indexation by Google: typical timeline, percentage that get indexed, any known issues. Does Cloudflare's CDN/caching affect Googlebot crawling? Are there any Cloudflare-specific robots.txt defaults?

Vercel deployment Google indexation: how long does it take, what percentage get indexed, does Vercel's edge network affect crawling? Are there reports of Vercel pages being deindexed or marked as spam?
Surge.sh pages indexation by Google: are they indexed? How long does it take? Does Google treat surge.sh subdomains differently from custom domains? Any known issues with Surge and Google indexation?

Telegraph.ph pages — Google indexation rate and timeline. Does Google treat Telegraph links as valuable? Are Telegraph pages frequently deindexed? Has Google made any changes to how it treats Telegraph in 2025-2026?
GitHub Pages sites Google indexation: typical timeline, success rate, does GitHub's domain authority (DA 95+) pass to GitHub Pages subdomains? Are github.io backlinks still effective for SEO in 2026?

Best practices for gradually unblocking robots.txt pages. We have 27 GitLab Pages and 36 Cloudflare Pages blocked by robots.txt. Plan: unblock 5 per platform per week. Is this pace safe? What signals does Google send when pages are unblocked?

GitLab Pages robots.txt: how to customize it for specific paths. Can you set different robots.txt rules per GitLab Pages project? How to allow specific pages while keeping others blocked? Technical implementation details.

Cloudflare Pages robots.txt configuration: how to customize per-page rules, how to serve a custom robots.txt, can you use _headers or _redirects files? Technical implementation for selectively unblocking pages.

After unblocking pages in robots.txt, how long does Google take to re-crawl and re-index? Does using Google's URL Inspection tool or IndexNow speed this up? What's the recommended approach for a gradual unblock of 60+ pages?

Risk assessment: unblocking 5 GitLab Pages and 5 Cloudflare Pages from robots.txt during a backlink cooling period. We have 984 backlinks, paused all deployment, and are waiting for velocity risk to decrease. Is unblocking robots.txt pages safe? Could it trigger additional crawling that looks like new link building?
robots.txt best practices 2026: has Google changed how it respects robots.txt? Any updates to the robots.txt specification? New features or deprecations? Does noindex in robots.txt still work?

Google algorithm updates June 2026: list ALL confirmed and rumored algorithm updates from May 15 to June 9, 2026. Include: core updates, spam updates, link spam updates, helpful content updates, any other changes. Be thorough.

Google's most recent link spam update: when was it, what did it specifically target, what types of links were devalued? How does it relate to SpamBrain? Were static hosting platform links (Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, Surge.sh) specifically targeted?

Google SpamBrain 2026: what are the latest known capabilities? Does it detect: (1) automated link building across static hosting platforms? (2) repetitive article patterns with similar anchors? (3) temporal burst patterns? (4) cross-platform deployment from same content source? Give detailed analysis.

Chrome extension backlink profiles: what does a NORMAL, healthy backlink profile look like for a Chrome extension with 5000+ users? How many backlinks, from what types of domains, at what velocity? Compare to our profile: 984 backlinks from 9 platforms in 10 days.

Does Google devalue backlinks from static hosting platforms (Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, Surge.sh, GitHub Pages, GitLab Pages)? Are these treated as 'free hosting' links with reduced value? Any evidence from SEO experiments or case studies?

HuggingFace Spaces as backlink sources: does Google treat HuggingFace.co (DR 89) backlinks as high value? Are static Spaces indexed? Do they pass PageRank? Any known issues with HuggingFace pages and Google indexation?

After a 14-day backlink deployment pause (from 984 links in 10 days), what is a safe velocity to resume automated link building? Give specific numbers: links per day, links per week, for the first month after resuming. Consider the site is a Chrome extension (belikenative.com).

Best backlink diversification strategy after a burst deployment of 984 links across 9 platforms. All current links are from static hosting and blog platforms. What types of NEW link sources should we add? Prioritize by: (1) ease of acquisition, (2) link value, (3) natural appearance.

Top 20 software directory submission platforms for Chrome extensions, ranked by Domain Authority. For each: name, DA/DR, dofollow or nofollow, free tier available, submission process (manual/API), typical approval time. Focus on platforms that accept browser extensions.

How to build a natural-looking backlink velocity for a Chrome extension over 3 months. Starting from 984 existing links, target 2000 links by month 3. Give a week-by-week plan with exact numbers, link types, and platforms. Must look organic to Google.

Medium.com backlinks for SaaS and Chrome extensions: are they still dofollow in 2026? How effective are they? What's the best strategy — own publication or guest posts? Does Medium's metered paywall affect link value? Any risks?

Write.as REST API for automated article publishing: API documentation, rate limits, authentication, how to create posts with backlinks. Is Write.as a viable platform for automated backlink deployment at scale (50+ articles)?

Blogger API v3 for automated blog creation and posting: complete setup guide, OAuth requirements, rate limits, can you create multiple blogs? How many posts per blog? Is automated Blogger posting detectable by Google as spam?

Case studies of websites that received Google manual actions specifically for automated link building on hosting platforms (GitHub Pages, Vercel, Cloudflare, etc). What happened? How long did recovery take? What remediation steps worked? Give 3-5 real examples.

Grammarly's backlink profile analysis: approximately how many backlinks does Grammarly have? From what types of domains? What's their link velocity? How did they build their backlink profile as a Chrome extension? Use this as a benchmark for belikenative.com.

LanguageTool's backlink profile: how many backlinks, from what types of domains, link velocity over time. How does a mid-size grammar/translation Chrome extension build links organically? Compare to our 984 links in 10 days.

Google disavow file best practices 2026: when to use disavow, what to include, format specification, how long does disavow take to process, does disavowing links hurt if the links weren't penalized? Should we pre-emptively disavow our lowest-quality links (Surge.sh, Firebase)?

Complete Sprint 8 strategy recommendation for belikenative.com backlink pipeline. Context: 984 links from 9 platforms deployed in 10 days (Sprint 6), currently on 14-day hold (Sprint 7). After Jun 17 resume, what should Sprint 8 look like? Give: target link count, platforms, velocity, timeline (2 weeks), risk mitigation. Must keep velocity risk below 4/10.
